phq9.title: PHQ-9 Mental Health Screener
phq9.subtitle: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by:
phq9.q1: 1. Little interest or pleasure in doing things
phq9.q3: 3. Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
phq9.q4: 4. Feeling tired or having little energy
phq9.q6: 6. Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure
phq9.q8: 8. Moving or speaking slowly, or being fidgety/restless
phq9.q9: 9. Thoughts that you would be better off dead or hurting yourself
